name: Quote
definition: Indicates whether the quote details are indicated as an offer, a bid or a mid of a security, commodity, currency (the latter being an average of the offer and the bid).

ValidUntilDateTime.name: Valid Until Date Time
ValidUntilDateTime.definition: Expresses the validity date and time of the Quote.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Can be used to specify the desired currency of the quoted price that may differ from the normal trading currency of the instrument being quote requested.

MaximumQuantity.name: Maximum Quantity
MaximumQuantity.definition: Specifies the maximum quantity of the financial instrument.

MinimumQuantity.name: Minimum Quantity
MinimumQuantity.definition: Specifies the minimal quantity of the financial instrument.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role played by a party in a quotation process.

RelatedNegotiation.name: Related Negotiation
RelatedNegotiation.definition: Negotiation process during which quotes are provided.

QuotedRate.name: Quoted Rate
QuotedRate.definition: Exchange rate specified in a quote.

PreviousClosingPrice.name: Previous Closing Price
PreviousClosingPrice.definition: Previous closing price of the financial instrument - Useful for verifying its identification.

RequestedPrice.name: Requested Price
RequestedPrice.definition: Is used to specify the desired currency of the quoted price when they differ from the normal trading currency of the instrument being quote requested.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Indicates the price of the instrument, applicable to the quote.

MarketPrice.name: Market Price
MarketPrice.definition: Used by markets to indicate the current best bid and offer.

MidSideQuoteVariable.name: Mid Side Quote Variable
MidSideQuoteVariable.definition: Quote details for which mid information is provided.

BidSideQuoteVariable.name: Bid Side Quote Variable
BidSideQuoteVariable.definition: Quote details for which bid information is provided.

OfferSideQuoteVariable.name: Offer Side Quote Variable
OfferSideQuoteVariable.definition: Quote details for which offer information is provided.

SecurityQuoteVariable.name: Security Quote Variable
SecurityQuoteVariable.definition: Proposition of price for a financial instrument.

QuoteSwap.name: Quote Swap
QuoteSwap.definition: Characteristics and conditions, quoted by the seller, by which a borrower can exchange one type of fund for another.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Provide the status for the quote.
